parsed.note_claim: A Nov 2025 anhydrous ammonia leak from a tanker truck at a Holiday Inn Express in Weatherford OK led to dozens hospitalized, hundreds evacuated, and no fatalities, rather than a catastrophic tank rupture with a 60-mile kill zone.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Forty-five people were hospitalized in the incident, including five who were airlifted to Oklahoma City-area hospitals, police said in an update Thursday evening.
parsed.reason: The page confirms the Nov 2025 tanker truck ammonia leak at a Weatherford Holiday Inn Express with dozens hospitalized and no fatalities, though it does not mention hundreds evacuated or the video's identity.
